caption: The drawing depicts a balcony railing in black ink on an off-white background, featuring wrought iron elements with ornate decorative patterns. The railing consists of multiple vertical balusters, each with a twisted, sinuous shape, connected at the top and bottom by horizontal bars. Square decorative elements are attached to the balusters at mid-height. In the center, there is a more intricate design featuring symmetrical scrollwork and a prominent shell-like ornament at the base. Behind the railing, part of a brick wall is visible in outline, with some bricks and mortar lines drawn. Above the railing, there are two closed window shutters, each shown with hinges and slats. The top left section of the wall is partially sketched to suggest unfinished or broken plaster, revealing brickwork underneath. There are also lines and marks indicating dimensions and measurements around the edges of the drawing.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
